data.description: The zipper stays closed because the orange part keeps making suggestions. I have learned not to encourage it.

At this point, the pairs never end…  

Pair after pair after pair..  

Infinite pairs. Infinite taxes..  

Might as well just send the Infinite Pair..

Many bon
